reader.requirement: At 1985, in INSPECT formats 1 and 3 the TALLYING counter identifier-2 must reference an elementary numeric data item, so the compiler refuses an alphanumeric, alphabetic, numeric-edited, group or index-data-item counter and a reference-modified numeric counter (which is class and category alphanumeric by IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5), and accepts any numeric item (display, COMP, signed, scaled, subscripted).

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the same check, and the same failure, at 85 and 2023

reader.notes: CheckInspectTallyCounter asks the BASE item's PICTURE, so a reference-modified numeric counter passes as numeric and the emitter then produces C# that Roslyn refuses; every other category is refused correctly. Same mechanism as kb/Work PB5734 (StrUnstrIsInteger), whose 2026-11-15 addendum names this row; PB5734 is status landed but the INSPECT arm still fails in this tree (d92742fe62).
reader.harm: under-rejects; misleads-diagnosis (the user sees a C# CS1503 backend error, exit 70, instead of the COBOL rule)
